name: Brno University of Technology
summary: Technical university in Brno with five English-taught bachelor's: civil, electrical and mechanical engineering, architecture and entrepreneurship.

handoff.label: English-taught programmes by faculty and level

ib.text: BUT publishes no IB rule; its faculties ask foreign applicants to request an assessment of their diploma (about EUR 30). Czech law has accepted the IB Diploma without nostrification since March 2025.

dates.label: Electrical Engineering entrance exam week (22–26 March)

programmes.name: Architecture and Urban Design
programmes.about: A four-year, studio-based bachelor's in architecture and urban design covering theory, technical and professional practice, with themes such as sustainability, climate resilience and housing.
programmes.ib: Three-day design homework and an online interview; B2 English certificate unless your secondary school taught in English.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on the admission exam: a three-day homework task, then an online interview. Up to 30 admitted. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Civil Engineering
programmes.about: A three-year civil engineering bachelor's specialised in building construction, taught at a faculty with its own materials and structures research centre (AdMaS) and close links to the construction industry.
programmes.ib: No written exam: documents, then a 15-minute online interview. B2 English certificate needed; school GPA at least 2.5 of 4.
programmes.selectionNote: Documents screened (motivation letter, transcript, English certificate), then an interview on English, motivation and basic maths and physics; 10 of 20 recommends you.

programmes.name: Electrical Engineering
programmes.about: Electrical engineering with a choice of two specialisations: Electronics and Communication Technologies, or Power Systems and Automation, built on mathematics, physics and electronics.
programmes.ib: Written entrance test in maths, physics and informatics at school level, plus an English assessment.
programmes.selectionNote: Entrance exam in Brno in late March after the January deadline. Your school certificate is due soon after applying; as an IB student, ask FEEC for an extension.

programmes.name: Entrepreneurship and Small Business Development
programmes.about: A practice-led business bachelor's: marketing, management and finance in year one, then you build and run a company with a team through entrepreneurial practice courses.
programmes.ib: Oral group interview in English on motivation, problem solving, teamwork and presentation.
programmes.selectionNote: Group interview scored out of 100; 30 to pass, then ranked for up to 80 places. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Fundamentals of Mechanical Engineering
programmes.about: A broad engineering bachelor's: mathematics, physics, materials, CAD and machine design first, then mechanics and manufacturing, before choosing a specialised master's.
programmes.ib: Maths and physics entrance exam, waived for a top-50% Scio result; English B1 (a school letter that you were taught in English is enough).
programmes.selectionNote: Written maths and physics exam; ask for a waiver if you placed in the top half of Scio's General Study Prerequisites or Mathematics test. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

notes: Each faculty runs its own admission, dates and fees (EUR 28–30 per application); apply to each programme in the BUT e-application.
Czech law accepts an IB Diploma as proof of secondary education without nostrification; ask your faculty whether its assessment fee still applies to you.
Civil Engineering wants a B2 English certificate even from IB students; Architecture and Mechanical Engineering accept English-medium schooling.
